page.content:
Carpenter's credit for Myers as force more than man.

How The Shape connects

  • Character: Michael Myers — Michael is billed and remembered as the Shape.
  • Creator: Nick Castle — Nick Castle first embodied the Shape on screen.
  • Artist: John Carpenter — Carpenter designed Michael as the Shape rather than a talkative killer.

What is The Shape?

The Shape is the film's name for Michael as an almost impersonal force — a white mask, coveralls, and a walk that reads as evil without motive.

Key threads lead to Michael Myers, Nick Castle and John Carpenter.
